 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. ORLANDO — UCF and Arizona State meet in a similar situation. With both Big 12 football teams sitting 5-4 overall and 3-3 in the conference, another victory would push them to bowl eligibility . But only one squad will achieve that this week.
 The Knights host the Sun Devils at 5:30 p.m. Saturday at Acrisure Bounce House , two hours later than planned after ASU's flight was delayed by the FAA ground stop . The teams' previous two matchups came in Tempe, Arizona. The contest will air on ESPNU.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Keep an eye on the quarterbacks. Alonza Barnett III will make his second straight start for UCF. He charged the Knights to a game-winning drive at Kansas last Saturday. His counterpart, Jake Fette, is a highly touted freshman, making only his third collegiate start for ASU .

 UCF football game updates, analysis vs Arizona State
 Get real-time updates, scoring plays, turning points and expert analysis throughout UCF's game against Arizona State. Follow along for the latest from the Daytona Beach News-Journal.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Arizona State, UCF trade punts to start
 05:49 PM ET, November 14 2026, Chris Boyle 
 Neither Arizona State nor UCF produced points on their opening possessions of the day, though Alonza Barnett III ripped a 23-yard completion to Caden Piening.
 The game is tied 0-0 with nine minutes left in the first quarter.
 True freshman Cardae Mack has three carries for 15 yards for Arizona State.
 UCF DT Horace Lockett inactive
 05:39 PM ET, November 14 2026, Chris Boyle 
 Starting defensive tackle Horace Lockett Jr. is a surprise inactive for UCF, dressed in street clothes along the sideline.
 The Knights are also without starting running back Duke Watson, wide receiver Waden Charles and safety Demari Henderson.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement UCF wins coin toss, defers kickoff
 05:35 PM ET, November 14 2026, Chris Boyle 
 UCF will send its defense onto the field first against Arizona State after winning the coin toss and deferring its option to the second half.
 Former UCF quarterback Mikey Keene was one of the Sun Devils' four captains. The Knights sent Alonza Barnett III, Lewis Carter, Brady Wayburn and Jayden Williams out to midfield for the toss.
